name: The Resurrection
overview: The Resurrection is a foundational truth revealed in Scripture, affirming that believers will be recompensed at the resurrection of the just, as Jesus taught (Luke 14:14). The Gospel accounts describe the discovery of the empty tomb and the angelic proclamation, confirming Christ’s victory over death (Luke 24:1,4). Martha’s confident declaration that the dead will rise again on the last day (John 11:24) highlights the future hope of resurrection, while Revelation 1:18 declares Christ’s eternal life and authority over death. This truth is grounded in God’s love demonstrated through Christ’s sacrificial death on our behalf (Romans 5:8), assuring believers of eternal life through Him.
